assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a standalone portrait artwork for a Three Kingdoms strategy game's hero card and avatar, to join a set of Cao Cao in midnight blue armor, Guan Yu in jade robes, Zhang Fei in black iron, Zhou Yu in ivory/crimson and Sun Shangxiang in crimson/teal.
Primary request: Lü Bu / 吕布, five-star Warrior, signature skill "Peerless Frenzy / 无双乱舞". One powerful athletic adult Chinese warrior with a fierce composed expression, sharp handsome face, dark hair and his distinctive tall twin long pheasant plumes on a bronze battle crown. Heavy blackened steel lamellar armor with antique gold bronze details, rich crimson silk cloak and red tassels. His iconic Fangtian painted halberd (方天画戟): long straight shaft, a long central spear point and two symmetric side crescent blades at the head. He holds the weapon naturally, diagonally beside his armored torso. Energetic three-quarter stance expressing unrivaled martial strength; a subtle red-gold arc of wind and drifting embers in the background evokes his skill without hiding face or weapon.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted East Asian historical fantasy card illustration, richly layered painterly strokes, precise ink contours, semi-realistic adult face, beautifully worked bronze and steel, dramatic readable lighting. Deep saturated accents over controlled dark masses; cohesive with premium Chinese strategy game collectible cards, not a photograph, not a 3D render, not chibi.
Composition: portrait 35:48 aspect ratio. Full-bleed opaque rectangular illustration. Figure framed thigh-up, face centered in upper third and large enough at a 350x480 thumbnail. Keep crown and plume tips inside canvas with breathing space; character occupies most of the frame; clear weapon silhouette. Face and upper body must dominate rather than a horse. One person only.
Background: painterly stormy battlefield haze with distant out-of-focus banners, warm rim light, subdued blue-gray and deep red, no foreground soldiers.
Constraints: NO text, calligraphy, letters, numbers, frame, border, card UI, star badges, watermark, signature, collage, or extra limbs. Original finished illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-screen BACKGROUND ONLY for a Three Kingdoms hero roster UI, behind detailed colorful portrait cards, white title at top center, ivory/gold small footer text and buttons at bottom.
Primary request: replace a noisy burning siege-city background with a dignified quiet Chinese historical fantasy painted environment that supports the card art. A mist-filled ancient military academy courtyard on a mountain terrace, only a small elegant Han-inspired pavilion with dark wooden pillars and bronze trim on the FAR RIGHT EDGE, layered distant blue-gray mountains and restrained clouds in the upper background, a broad uninterrupted dark stone court and very soft painterly haze across the central and left 75 percent. Subtle aged silk/ink-brush texture integrated into the paint.
Style: premium hand-painted East Asian fantasy game environment, visible broad brushwork and delicate ink edges, richly crafted but low-contrast, slightly stylized, cohesive with illustrated bronze armor and flowing silk character cards. Color palette: deep desaturated jade, slate blue, charcoal, muted warm antique bronze highlights. Calm martial nobility, gentle atmospheric light.
Composition: exact 16:9 landscape, requested 1920x1080. Important: the left and center must remain visually quiet and fairly DARK for many portrait cards to appear on top. The top-center title zone and bottom footer band must also be dark enough for white/cream text; no bright sunlight disc. Soft vignette at edges, no artificial panel divisions or UI placeholders. Decorative pavilion stays small in far right outer quarter, architectural details do not dominate. Horizon high and faint. At 1280x720 this should read as a refined atmospheric backdrop, not compete with the portraits.
Constraints: Background only, NO people, heroes, soldiers, weapons in foreground, horse, fire, burning city, explosions, destroyed buildings, busy battlefield, orange sky, huge landmark, text, letters, calligraphy, numbers, logos, watermarks, card borders, UI elements or buttons. Full bleed opaque raster illustration.
